references.text: Jesus teaches in the synagogues throughout Galilee, showing a parallel to his ministry in Mark 1:39.
Jesus preaches in the synagogues of Judea, which is a parallel action to the preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
Jesus' ministry involves teaching in the synagogue, reflecting his actions in Mark 1:39.
The act of driving out evil spirits points to a similar exercise of power as in Mark 1:39.
